cohort: Pregnant mothers attending antenatal care at three teaching hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (n=19,797 deliveries, 80 with pregestational diabetes mellitus).
finding: The prevalence of pregestational diabetes mellitus was 0.4%, with poor glycemic control throughout pregnancy associated with adverse outcomes like higher rates of induction of labor (67.1%), cesarean section (61.8%), hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (28.5%), premature delivery, and neonatal intensive care referral (53.4%).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was 61.8% among women with pregestational diabetes.
